project.name: OpenNBS
project.description:
We create software to advance the Minecraft note block music creation ecosystem. We have two mainline projects: Note Block Studio and Note Block World.

Note Block Studio is an application that makes it easy for anyone to create music for Minecraft.

Note Block World is a platform where users can discover note block creations shared by other users and upload their own. It encourages fellow note block musicians to collaborate in an open ecosystem.
